get.summary: Get a valid Swagger 2.0 document with all REST APIs available from a WebSphere Application Server tradional instance
get.description: Returns a valid Swagger 2.0 document with all REST APIs available from a WebSphere Application Server tradional instance merged into a single document. This is useful for consumer applications that want to programmatically navigate the set of available APIs, such as an API Management solution. By default, the document is returned in JSON format. Including an optional 'Accept' header with an 'application/yaml' value provides the document in YAML format. This endpoint has two multiple-cardinality, optional query parameters called 'root' that can filter the found context roots and 'compact' that can control whether the output should be formatted or not.

parameters.name: compact
parameters.description: Indicates if the output will contain any indenting white spaces, new line feeds, etc. By default, the output will not be compacted

200.description: All available or filtered REST APIs from a WebSphere Application Server tradional instance merged into a single document

415.description: Requested media type is not supported
